title: File:Casa Rosada, Buenos Aires 2012-05-22 01.JPG
claims: The photograph shows the full pink facade of the Casa Rosada across the Plaza de Mayo side, with its central arch, balconies, fence, street furniture and pedestrians; it is a city landmark view, not a race arch, timing mat, aid station, closed course or race-day crowd.

The file page identifies the subject as the Casa Rosada in Buenos Aires; it gives no camera coordinate, so the route page records only the landmark named by the file page and does not infer a precise shooting point on the race course.
The author is Anastasiya Lvova; the file is licensed CC BY 3.0; the photograph was taken on 2012-05-22 at 20:20:40; the original is 3,456 x 2,304 pixels and 3,640,849 bytes.
The route page uses a 960 x 640 copy of 173,274 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Anastasiya Lvova, CC BY 3.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
